fields.gap: SiC's 3900 MPa is a crushing value; 008's own NFI carries that flexural ~380 MPa governs any bending or tension path, with brittle fracture, joining and handling unresolved. A 0.04 m radius sintered SiC tube of 1.3 mm wall is undemonstrated.
fields.direction: Treat the SiC row as a material-boundary statement (sigma/rho headroom), not a buildable tube.
fields.effect: The P3 sigma/rho-bound conclusion stands; the SiC design point does not.
